items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: He told me the whole story... The great Ballantine, that's his name. Carl Ballantine... one of the nicest fellas you ever knew in your life.

ctx.x: Mac Hales Navy. Mac Hales Navy. All right. This guy called... What caused this guy to do what he did? He was a real fine magician. But he wasn't making a dime. He told me the whole story. And he got real sick. Laying in the hospital, he got to thinking. He said, suppose I make a comedy act out of it and foul up everything that I do. The great Ballantine, that's his name. Carl Ballantine. So, he got out there and everything that he did, he fouled up. It didn't work. But he made such a to-do out of it that he went…

Yeah. Well, he was a singer, too. Did you ever hear him sing? Johnny? No. I never heard him sing once, but I know he used to sing. I think I've even seen pictures of him on the band. I hear him down the wall.
